## Summary

Describe the proposed change and why it is needed.

## Scientific impact

- [ ] Documentation / packaging only; no numerical algorithm changes.
- [ ] Geometry, PBC, template or candidate-screening behavior changed.
- [ ] Energy model, random sampling, relaxation or stop semantics changed.
- [ ] Original scientific data, source config or provenance affected.

## Validation

- [ ] Reviewed all modified scientific configuration fields.
- [ ] Ran lightweight input-builder tests locally (no growth simulation).
- [ ] Updated case docs, reproducibility notes and affected tests.
- [ ] Did not include heavyweight results, private paths or credentials.

## Limitations and reviewer notes

Describe unanswered questions, any change of numerical behavior and
what physical validation would be required before publication.
